name: How long does a typical structural remodeling project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical structural remodeling project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a structural remodeling project depends heavily on its complexity and the extent of the changes. A project involving the removal of a single load-bearing wall might take a few weeks, including design, permitting, and construction. More extensive projects, like adding an extension or foundation repair, could easily extend to several months. Delays can occur due to permit approvals, material availability, or unforeseen issues discovered during demolition. Your contractor should provide a realistic timeline before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary; a single load-bearing wall removal might take weeks, while larger projects can last several months, depending on complexity and permits.
